definitions.explanation: A type of vehicle transmission that requires manual gear shifting using a clutch pedal and gear stick.

examples.japanese: MT⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}できる→運転する：20318_untensuru⟧?
MT⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: Driving a manual is more fun.

examples.japanese: MT⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていれば→持つ：00478_motsu⟧、AT⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}できる→運転する：20318_untensuru⟧。
examples.english: If you have an MT license, you can also drive automatic cars.

notes:
Abbreviation of "Manual Transmission." In Japan, MT cars are becoming rare but driving enthusiasts still prefer them.

COMPOUNDS:
- MT⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧: manual transmission car
- MT⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧: MT driver's license
- MT⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}→解除：05762_kaijo⟧: removing the AT-only restriction on a license

LICENSING IN JAPAN:
Japanese driver's licenses come in two types:
- MT⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧: allows driving both MT and AT vehicles
- AT⟦{限定|げんてい}{免許|めんきょ}→限定免許：24957_genteimenkyo⟧: allows driving only AT vehicles

Many people now choose the AT-only license since almost all passenger cars in Japan are automatic.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- MT (⟦マニュアル→マニュアル：26993_manyuaru⟧): manual transmission
- AT (⟦オートマ→オートマ：29984_ootoma⟧): automatic transmission
